sprint_8.name: command-center-v1
sprint_8.note: Exact-content approval. An approval binds to a candidate UUID, a fingerprint over every proposed byte, the paths, the provider, the model, the project and the task. IMPLEMENT recomputes all of it and refuses on any difference.

sprint_9.name: execution-safety-and-recovery

repair.name: cookie-transport-pipeline-repair
repair.note: ACTIVATION HELD on 2026-08-03. Pre-flight proved that attaching AdminSessionIdentity would have locked every administrator out: EncryptCookies (web group) nulled the plaintext cookie written by the api group, so a VALID token was answered with a redirect to a login page that reissued the same cookie. The direct-invocation suite could not see it — the defect is in the composition, not in handle(). Repaired in bootstrap/app.php and certified through the real HTTP kernel before any activation.

second_lockout_path.note: Independent of the cookie-encryption defect and equally fatal. Found before activation by reading what the login page does when the server starts refusing. Both blockers shared one shape: each half correct, the composition not.
